The evidence now establishes:
1. Backlog grew from $30.0B to $51.2B during 2025, an increase of $21.2B (E7)
2. The largest increase was in Power & Energy segment (E7)
3. Power Generation demand (within Power & Energy) was "driven by increasing energy demands to support data center growth related to cloud computing and generative artificial intelligence" (E1, E2)

Since Power & Energy had the largest backlog increase among all segments, and Power Generation (driven by data centers) is a major component of Power & Energy, the evidence supports that data center demand was the primary driver of the overall backlog growth in 2025.
